cohort: Pregnant women aged 15 to 45 with gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM)
finding: Metformin was associated with a reduced risk of planned elective c-section, large for gestational age, and neonatal hypoglycemia compared with insulin in women with GDM.
mod_finding: The study found that metformin, compared to insulin, was associated with a reduced risk of planned elective c-section in women with gestational diabetes.
